article.title: Naqvi says new administrative units to be formed only with people's consent
article.summary: Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi on Saturday said that any new administrative units in the country would only be formed if the people voiced their support for such a move.Addressing the National Policy Dialogue in Lahore, he said, “Reset does not mean breaking the system. Under no circumstances does it mean breaking the system. It means that whatever is wrong should be changed.”Naqvi stressed that the changes should be brought through “political consensus” and “according to the will of our people”. He added that if the nation did not want the new administrative units, they would not be created.He emphasised that such a change could not be brought about only based on the will of an individual, a political party or a government.“And this would only happen if the people want it and consent to it,” he maintained.The interior minister called for a dialogue that would consider the positive and negative aspects of new units. “Draft a thing and present it to the people, asking them whether th...

article.title: Naqvi says decision on new provinces must reflect public will
article.summary: Pakistan Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi has vowed not to back down from his demand for new provinces, saying any decision on the matter must reflect the will of the people.Addressing the National Policy Dialogue in Lahore on Saturday, Naqvi said whether he remained in office or not, he would not back down from the demand for new administrative units.He said the current National Finance Commission (NFC) award policy incentivises “an increase in population for a greater share of resources”, asking, “Is this not a ticking bomb foretelling impending collapse?
